use_restriction: Non-commercial research only; commercial integration or resale is prohibited by the provider's terms.
citation: Jorda, Schularick, and Taylor (2017), Macrofinancial History and the New Business Cycle Facts; return data: Jorda, Knoll, Kuvshinov, Schularick, and Taylor (2019), The Rate of Return on Everything, 1870-2015.

variables_used.eq_tr: Nominal equity total return, local currency, decimal ratio.
variables_used.bond_tr: Nominal government bond total return, local currency, decimal ratio.
variables_used.bill_rate: Nominal government bill return coupon[t]/price[t-1], local currency, decimal ratio.
variables_used.housing_tr: Nominal housing total return, local currency, decimal ratio.
variables_used.cpi: Consumer price index, 1990=100; annual inflation is derived from the exact-calendar-year ratio.
variables_used.crisisJST: Systemic financial crisis 0-1 indicator; one in the documented onset year.
